name: RWU's Forensic Science Summer Camp
description_short: A one-week overnight forensic science camp at Roger Williams University for students entering or in grades 10–12. Students work with RWU forensic scientists on fingerprinting, footwear evidence, chemical analysis and crime scenes in virtual reality, and can use campus recreation and waterfront facilities.
refund_policy_summary: A $500 deposit is due at registration and is fully refundable before April 1. The remaining balance is due by May 1. (The camp page still prints these deadlines as April 1, 2026 and May 1, 2026; the 2027 registration form says only 'refundable before April 1'.)
swim_waterfront_notes: Campers have access to the recreation center, sailing center, kayaks and the RWU waterfront. The page does not describe swim testing or supervision.
